Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit 268425970342d0399c0dcf5acfafde1c58270d5e

https://deploy-preview-3600--instantsearchjs.netlify.com
GitHub seems to also display the changes introduced in #3599, that's weird.
These changes seem to be a different PR? Not sure what to review here
I think the `base` might be wrong :)

As said in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3600#issuecomment-472837790 I think that's a GitHub bug. You can ignore the changes related to Storybook.

**Edit**: I rebased again, should be fixed!

Without custom CSS classes, the inserted `div` container is not easily customizable because nothing identifies it. I think we should create an [InstantSearch.css](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch-specs) spec for this widget with the following markup: ```html
``` It would imply adding a `cssClasses` option to the widget, like in most widgets. WDYT?
